channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Some sunshine Friday afternoon, pleasant and warm this weekend
item.description: Friday night looks a bit cooler, with lows in the upper 40s. Our weekend weather looks wonderful, with sunshine, no rain, and high temperatures in the mid 70s Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: Several Days Of Spring-Like Warmth Ahead
item.description: We could see temps climb into the lower 80s late next week.

item.title: Man to spend life behind bars for shooting at Montgomery gas station
item.description: A man recently found guilty for attempted murder and illegally possessing a gun in 2022 will now spend the rest of his life behind bars.

item.title: What to know about the new US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Saturday in what President Donald Trump said was a massive operation to destroy the country’s military capabilities and eliminate the threat of it creating a nuclear weapon.

item.title: One man is dead after a fatal Sunday morning shooting in Montgomery
item.description: Montgomery police are investigating an early morning shooting that left one man dead.

item.title: Shots fired on Atlanta Highway leads to brief pursuit
item.description: Atlanta Highway shooting leads to police pursuit just after midnight.

item.title: Israel hits Tehran as Trump signals willingness to talk with Iran’s new leaders
item.description: U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran continued for a second day on Sunday after the killing of Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei threw the future of the Islamic Republic into uncertainty and raised the risk of regional instability.

item.title: Two women critically injured after two-vehicle crash in Montgomery
item.description: The crash happened in the area of Eastern Boulevard and Buckboard Road around 2:10 a.m. Sunday.

item.title: Suspect in Texas shooting wore ‘Property of Allah’ clothing and Iranian flag emblem
item.description: The gunman who killed two people at a bar in Texas early Sunday in a mass shooting is being investigated by the FBI as a potential act of terrorism as he was wearing a sweatshirt that said “Property of Allah,” and another shirt with an Iranian flag design.

item.title: Two dead in Montgomery murder-suicide
item.description: Montgomery police are investigating a murder-suicide that left a man and a woman dead.
